messages:
mike: Quick sync — final gate for tonight's deploy at 22:00 UTC. I'm the deploy lead. Please confirm rollback runbook is reviewed and we have a live escape hatch.

anna: On it. Reviewing runbook now: https://docs.internal/redwood/deploys/runbook-3

sanjay: From infra side: autoscaler will be frozen at 21:50 UTC. Nothing to change unless rollback needed.

eva: QA smoke checklist run locally against staging, all green except a flaky embed test (retry passes). Marking as note. :white_check_mark:

mike: Key rollback commands below (docs link in thread). Putting them here for quick access:
```
# rollback to prior release tag
./scripts/rollout rollback --tag=release-2026-03-15 --confirm
# emergency toggle off
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://ops.redwood/api/toggles/deployX/disable
```

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved 22:00-22:30 UTC. Canary nodes: 3. Alerting pinned to #eng-oncall.

qa-bot: Smoke endpoints checklist: /health, /generate, /embed. Expected lat < 200ms for /health. See logs attached.

anna: Rollback criteria (proposal):
- >=3% 5m error rate increase OR
- Canary lat p95 > 800ms OR
- Production embed net failure rate > 1%
Agree? If so I'll file as the official criteria.

sanjay: agree to criteria, add: any auth regression (5+ login failures/min) -> immediate rollback.

eva: QA gives a conditional go if the flaky embed test is annotated and monitor alert is set. I'll watch first 10m.

mike: OK final checklist: Anna files criteria, Sanjay freezes autoscaler, Eva watches, I'm sitting at the console. If no strong objections, call it a go at 21:55 UTC.

anna: Filed: https://tickets.internal/RED-8421 with the criteria.

sanjay: Autoscaler freeze scheduled.

eva: Watching. :eyes:

mike: Go for launch at 21:55 UTC unless any hold. If you want to trigger rollback, use commands above and ping #incidents.

anna: go

sanjay: go

eva: go

mike: go — initiating rollout in 5m. I'll post updates in this thread. :rocket:
